The '''Odryn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odryn]].
